name: kaampass
description: Digital work identity and verified employment history for informal workers.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @kaampass/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names WEB,API --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @kaampass/web" "npm run dev --workspace @kaampass/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kaampass/contracts && npm run build --workspace @kaampass/api && npm run build --workspace @kaampass/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @kaampass/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @kaampass/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @kaampass/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
